mapper.select: /* com.portal.user.poll.qri.QustnrRespondInfoMapper.selectQustnrRespondInfoManageStatistics1 */ SELECT A.QUSTNR_TMPLAT_ID AS qestnrTmplatId, A.QESTNR_ID, A.QUSTNR_QESITM_ID AS qestnrQesitmId, A.QUSTNR_IEM_ID, ( SELECT IEM_CN FROM LETTNQUSTNRIEM WHERE QUSTNR_IEM_ID = A.QUSTNR_IEM_ID ) AS IEM_CN, COUNT(A.QUSTNR_IEM_ID) AS QUSTNR_IEM_ID_CNT, ROUND((100 / ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM LETTNQUSTNRRSPNSRESULT WHERE QUSTNR_QESITM_ID = A.QUSTNR_QESITM_ID )) * COUNT(A.QUSTNR_IEM_ID)) AS QUSTNR_PERCENT FROM LETTNQUSTNRRSPNSRESULT A WHERE A.QESTNR_ID = #{qestnrId} AND A.QUSTNR_TMPLAT_ID = #{qestnrTmplatId} AND (A.QUSTNR_IEM_ID IS NOT NULL AND A.QUSTNR_IEM_ID != '') GROUP BY A.QUSTNR_TMPLAT_ID, A.QESTNR_ID, A.QUSTNR_QESITM_ID, A.QUSTNR_IEM_ID

/* com.portal.user.poll.qri.QustnrRespondInfoMapper.selectQustnrRespondInfoManageStatistics2 */ SELECT A.QUSTNR_TMPLAT_ID AS qestnrTmplatId, A.QESTNR_ID, A.QUSTNR_QESITM_ID AS qestnrQesitmId, A.QUSTNR_IEM_ID, A.ETC_ANSWER_CN, A.RESPOND_ANSWER_CN, A.RESPOND_NM FROM LETTNQUSTNRRSPNSRESULT A WHERE A.QESTNR_ID = #{qestnrId} AND A.QUSTNR_TMPLAT_ID = #{qestnrTmplatId} AND (A.QUSTNR_IEM_ID IS NULL OR A.QUSTNR_IEM_ID = '')

/* com.portal.user.poll.qri.QustnrRespondInfoMapper.selectQustnrRespondInfoManageComtnqestnrinfo */ SELECT A.QESTNR_ID, A.QUSTNR_SJ AS qestnrSj, A.QUSTNR_PURPS AS qestnrPurps, A.QUSTNR_WRITNG_GUIDANCE_CN AS qestnrWritngGuidanceCn, DATE_FORMAT(A.QUSTNR_BGNDE, '%Y-%m-%d') AS QESTNR_BEGIN_DE, DATE_FORMAT(A.QUSTNR_ENDDE, '%Y-%m-%d') AS QESTNR_END_DE, DATE_FORMAT(A.FRST_REGIST_PNTTM, '%Y-%m-%d') AS FRST_REGIST_PNTTM, A.FRST_REGISTER_ID, DATE_FORMAT(A.LAST_UPDT_PNTTM, '%Y-%m-%d') AS LAST_UPDT_PNTTM, A.LAST_UPDUSR_ID, A.QUSTNR_TRGET AS qestnrTrget, A.QUSTNR_TMPLAT_ID AS qestnrTmplatId FROM LETTNQESTNRINFO A WHERE A.QESTNR_ID = #{qestnrId} AND A.QUSTNR_TMPLAT_ID = #{qestnrTmplatId}

/* com.portal.user.poll.qri.QustnrRespondInfoMapper.selectQustnrRespondInfoManageComtnqustnrqesitm */ SELECT A.QUSTNR_QESITM_ID AS qestnrQesitmId, A.QESTNR_ID, DATE_FORMAT(A.FRST_REGIST_PNTTM, '%Y-%m-%d') AS FRST_REGIST_PNTTM, A.FRST_REGISTER_ID, DATE_FORMAT(A.LAST_UPDT_PNTTM, '%Y-%m-%d') AS LAST_UPDT_PNTTM, A.LAST_UPDUSR_ID, A.QESTN_SN, A.QESTN_TY_CODE, A.QESTN_CN, A.MXMM_CHOISE_CO, A.QUSTNR_TMPLAT_ID AS qestnrTmplatId FROM LETTNQUSTNRQESITM A WHERE A.QESTNR_ID = #{qestnrId} AND A.QUSTNR_TMPLAT_ID = #{qestnrTmplatId} ORDER BY A.QESTN_SN ASC

/* com.portal.user.poll.qri.QustnrRespondInfoMapper.selectQustnrRespondInfoManageComtnqustnriem */ SELECT A.QUSTNR_QESITM_ID AS qestnrQesitmId, A.QESTNR_ID, A.IEM_SN, DATE_FORMAT(A.FRST_REGIST_PNTTM, '%Y-%m-%d') AS FRST_REGIST_PNTTM, A.FRST_REGISTER_ID, DATE_FORMAT(A.LAST_UPDT_PNTTM, '%Y-%m-%d') AS LAST_UPDT_PNTTM, A.LAST_UPDUSR_ID, A.QUSTNR_IEM_ID, A.IEM_CN, A.ETC_ANSWER_AT, A.QUSTNR_TMPLAT_ID AS qestnrTmplatId FROM LETTNQUSTNRIEM A WHERE A.QESTNR_ID = #{qestnrId} AND A.QUSTNR_TMPLAT_ID = #{qestnrTmplatId} ORDER BY A.IEM_SN ASC

/* com.portal.user.poll.qri.QustnrRespondInfoMapper.selectQustnrRespondInfoDetail */ SELECT A.QUSTNR_RSPNS_RESULT_ID AS qestnrQesrspnsId, ( SELECT QUSTNR_SJ FROM LETTNQESTNRINFO WHERE QESTNR_ID = A.QESTNR_ID ) AS qestnrSj, ( SELECT QESTN_TY_CODE FROM LETTNQUSTNRQESITM WHERE QUSTNR_QESITM_ID = A.QUSTNR_QESITM_ID ) AS QESTN_TY_CODE, ( SELECT QESTN_CN FROM LETTNQUSTNRQESITM WHERE QUSTNR_QESITM_ID = A.QUSTNR_QESITM_ID ) AS QESTN_CN, ( SELECT IEM_CN FROM LETTNQUSTNRIEM WHERE QUSTNR_IEM_ID = A.QUSTNR_IEM_ID ) AS IEM_CN, A.QUSTNR_IEM_ID, A.QUSTNR_QESITM_ID AS qestnrQesitmId, A.QESTNR_ID, A.RESPOND_ANSWER_CN, A.RESPOND_NM, A.ETC_ANSWER_CN, A.QUSTNR_TMPLAT_ID AS qestnrTmplatId, DATE_FORMAT(A.FRST_REGIST_PNTTM, '%Y-%m-%d') AS FRST_REGIST_PNTTM, A.FRST_REGISTER_ID, DATE_FORMAT(A.LAST_UPDT_PNTTM, '%Y-%m-%d') AS LAST_UPDT_PNTTM, A.LAST_UPDUSR_ID FROM LETTNQUSTNRRSPNSRESULT A WHERE A.QUSTNR_RSPNS_RESULT_ID = #{qestnrQesrspnsId}

/* com.portal.user.poll.qri.QustnrRespondInfoMapper.selectQustnrRespondInfoListCnt */ SELECT COUNT(*) AS totcnt FROM LETTNQUSTNRRSPNSRESULT WHERE 1=1
AND ETC_ANSWER_CN LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%')
AND RESPOND_ANSWER_CN LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%')
AND RESPOND_NM LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%')
mapper.insert: /* com.portal.user.poll.qri.QustnrRespondInfoMapper.insertQustnrRespondInfo */ INSERT INTO LETTNQUSTNRRSPNSRESULT ( QUSTNR_RSPNS_RESULT_ID, QUSTNR_QESITM_ID, QESTNR_ID, QUSTNR_TMPLAT_ID, QUSTNR_IEM_ID, RESPOND_ANSWER_CN, RESPOND_NM, ETC_ANSWER_CN, FRST_REGIST_PNTTM, FRST_REGISTER_ID, LAST_UPDT_PNTTM, LAST_UPDUSR_ID ) VALUES ( #{qestnrQesrspnsId}, #{qestnrQesitmId}, #{qestnrId}, #{qestnrTmplatId}, #{qustnrIemId}, #{respondAnswerCn}, #{respondNm}, #{etcAnswerCn}, sysdate(), #{frstRegisterId}, sysdate(), #{lastUpdusrId} )
